run_EM_quantize_weight_matrix: run the EM algorithm to quantize a weight matrix W to k centroids minimizing reconstruction error
run_EM_step: run a single EM iteration performing E-step assignment and M-step centroid update on the weight matrix
run_EM_resolve_empty_clusters: run the empty cluster resolution logic that splits the most populated cluster to fill empty ones
run_EM_compute_distances: run the distance computation between all centroids and weight matrix columns using PyTorch broadcasting
run_EM_save_load: run the EM save and load methods to persist and restore centroids, assignments, and objective history
